/work/vellor-residency.title: Vellor Residency - My Framer Site
/work/vellor-residency.description: Belgrade-based Brand Designer specializing in brand identity, art direction, and visual storytelling. Portfolio of selected works across branding, print, and digital.
p: Vellor Residency is a contemporary residential development designed for modern urban living — a gated complex offering luxury apartments, private amenities, and rooftop penthouses, set for completion in 2028. The brief called for a brand identity that communicates architectural clarity, long-term value, and structural reliability — appealing equally to future residents and investors. The resulting visual system draws from a restrained palette of Gunmetal, Cadet Grey, and Light Blue, paired with Proxima Nova to balance authority with approachability. From construction signage and outdoor advertising to sales materials and digital presence, every touchpoint was crafted to position Vellor as more than a place to live — as a statement of intent.

/work/nordarch-studio.description: Belgrade-based Brand Designer specializing in brand identity, art direction, and visual storytelling. Portfolio of selected works across branding, print, and digital.
p: Nordarch Studio is a Belgrade-based architecture firm with a Nordic design philosophy — where structure meets restraint. The brief called for a visual identity that communicates authority, precision, and timelessness. The resulting brand system draws from raw textures, muted tones, and tight typographic hierarchy — reflecting the studio's approach to space and form. Every touchpoint, from business cards to digital presence, was crafted to feel intentional and enduring. The identity positions Nordarch as a studio that doesn't follow trends — it defines them.

/work/falco-gin.title: Falco Gin - My Framer Site
/work/falco-gin.description: Belgrade-based Brand Designer specializing in brand identity, art direction, and visual storytelling. Portfolio of selected works across branding, print, and digital.
p: Falco Gin is a handcrafted Swiss premium spirit defined by character, precision, and a bold sensory identity. Distilled in small batches and refined with a unique blend of botanicals and exotic fruits, the brand balances tradition with a contemporary edge. This project focused on translating that identity into a tactile, editorial experience. Through art direction and booklet design, the goal was to create a visual narrative that reflects the essence of Falco — raw, refined, and unapologetically expressive.

/about.title: Tumenko — Brand Designer
/about.description: Belgrade-based Brand Designer specializing in brand identity, art direction, and visual storytelling. Portfolio of selected works across branding, print, and digital.
p: I’m Dejan Tumenko, a brand designer based in Belgrade, Serbia. Since 2015 I’ve been building brand identities, packaging and websites that look simple and stand the test of time. I care about craft, I’m suspicious of trends, and I think a good brand is mostly the right decisions made quietly. When I’m not designing, I’m shooting with my Canon, printing photos, filling Field Notes, or in the middle of a true crime marathon.
Strategy-led visual systems: positioning, logos, typography, color and imagery guidelines that work everywhere your brand shows up.
Concepting and directing photo shoots and campaigns, so every image, layout and post tells the same story.
Labels, bottles, boxes and pouches designed to stand out on the shelf and stay true to what's inside.
Websites and digital products that carry the brand online, with clear structure, easy to use and built to convert.
Questioning the obvious answer, testing ideas early and keeping only what actually moves the brand forward. New for a reason, never just for show.
Finding the visual idea that belongs to one brand only. Every mark, layout and detail should feel made for that client, not pulled from a trend.
Striving for exceptional quality, precision, and attention to detail in every project, ensuring high standards and exceeding client expectations consistently.
Remaining true to our values, purpose, and mission, ensuring integrity, transparency, and honesty in all interactions, decisions, and actions, every day.
